newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria approves 1.5 bln levs harvest subsidies.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria approves 1.5 bln levs harvest subsidies.

text.p: Bulgaria's state Zemedelie agricultural fund will make subsidies of 1.5 billion levs ($882,000) available for purchases of machinery spare parts and fuel for this year's wheat harvest, its executive director said.

"Zemedelie's board approved yesterday subsidies amounting to 1.5 billion which should cover around 30 percent of the cost of harvesting the 1.2 million hectares sown with wheat," Nikola Nikolov told a news conference on Tuesday.
Agricultural producers will receive subsidies against invoices for spare parts, fuels and mechanical services.
He said the board also approved credits totalling 1.4 billion levs for 11 investment projects, which included long term investments like combine harvesters and livestock.
Interest on the credits will be set at one third of the central bank main interest rate plus three percentage points to be paid in 2-1/2 years.
This makes a 14.92 percent annual interest rate at the current main interest rate of 35.76 percent.
